brief:
An elderly man from Habla, south of Qalqiliya, was injured in a beating by settlers near Nablus in the northern West Bank on Tuesday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The attack left the man wounded, though details on the extent of his injuries were not immediately available.

The incident occurred as tensions remain high in the northern West Bank, where settler violence against Palestinian civilians has been a recurring concern.

title: Settlers assault elderly Palestinian near Nablus
